title: Fig & Mustard-Glazed Chicken with Roast Squash & Goat Cheese Rucola
description: One-tray chicken thighs lacquered with homemade fig jam, over roast butternut and red onion, topped with rucola, goat cheese and toasted walnuts.

ingredients.name: Butternut squash, peeled & seeded, 2.5 cm cubes (~1 kg whole)

steps.title: Heat the oven and prep the veg
steps.text: Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan). Cube the squash and cut the onions into wedges.

steps.title: Roast the veg
steps.text: Toss the squash and onion with 1½ tbsp olive oil, the thyme leaves and ½ tsp salt. Spread on a large lined tray and roast 15 min.

steps.title: Make the fig glaze
steps.text: Meanwhile whisk the fig jam, Dijon and balsamic with a pinch of salt until smooth. Set aside 2 tbsp of glaze for finishing.

steps.title: Glaze and roast the chicken
steps.text: Season the thighs with the remaining salt and brush with the main portion of glaze. Nestle them among the veg and roast 20 min. Brush with the reserved 2 tbsp glaze and roast 5 min more, until sticky and 75 °C in the thickest part.

steps.title: Toast the walnuts
steps.text: While the chicken finishes, toast the walnuts in a dry pan over medium heat for 3 min, then roughly chop.

steps.title: Rest, dress and split
steps.text: Rest the chicken 5 min. Toss the rucola with the remaining olive oil (about 1½ tsp) and a spoon of tray juices. Matthias: ≈400 g chicken, 500 g squash, most of the onion, 50 g goat cheese and the walnuts. Partner: ≈250 g chicken, 200 g squash, a few onion wedges, 20 g goat cheese. Rucola on top of both.

notes: Cook this second, within 2–3 days, while the rucola is still good.
